blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual world knowledge is a core capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), underpinning knowledge-intensive visual question answering and fine-grained visual reasoning. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in two key respects. First, their category coverage is narrow: most benchmarks span only a small number of categories across a few domains, falling far short of the open-ended scale of real-world visual entities. Second, their task construction is often insufficiently rigorous: models can answer correctly using coarse-grained cues, vague associations, or elimination strategies without truly mastering precise concepts, making it difficult to accurately assess their knowledge of fine-grained entities. We introduce VisualWorldBench, a taxonomy-grounded multi-task benchmark built on a hierarchical taxonomy of 21,291 leaf-node classes across 8 visual domains, with 32,541 evaluation instances whose ground-truth labels cover 15,479 categories across four complementary tasks: closed-set recognition, contrastive selection, precise localization, and open-world naming, covering different directions of knowledge retrieval and varying degrees of answer openness to comprehensively evaluate visual world knowledge. Most questions are constructed from taxonomically proximate categories, forcing precise discrimination among fine-grained entities. Experiments reveal that the strongest closed-source model achieves only 80.4% average accuracy, exposing capability gaps hidden under conventional benchmarks. We further construct VisualWorldBench-50K, a training resource covering 50K+ categories. Fine-tuning on VisualWorldBench-50K yields over 21 percentage points improvement on VisualWorldBench, with consistent transfer to public fine-grained recognition and visual knowledge benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 视觉世界知识是多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的核心能力,支持知识密集型视觉问题回答和精细的视觉推理. 然而,现有基准在两个主要方面仍然有限。 首先,它们的类别覆盖范围很窄:大多数基准只跨越少数领域的少数类别,远远低于现实世界视觉实体的开放式规模。 其次,他们的任务构建往往不够严格:模型可以使用粗糙的提示,模糊的关联,或者消除策略而不真正掌握精确的概念,从而难以准确评估他们对精细的纹理实体的知识. 我们介绍了VisualWorld Bench,这是一个基于分类学的多任务基准,该基准基于8个视觉领域的21,291个叶子-节点类的分级分类,共有32,541个评价实例,其地面-真伪标签涵盖15,479个类别,涉及四个互补任务:闭合识别、对比性选择、精确本地化和开放世界命名,涵盖知识检索的不同方向和不同程度的答案开放,以全面评价视觉世界知识。 多数问题都是从分类学的近似类别中得出的,迫使精细实体之间有确切的歧视。 实验显示,最强的闭源模型只达到80.4%的平均精度,暴露出传统基准下隐藏的能力差距. 我们进一步建造了VisualWorld Bench-50K,这是一个涵盖50K+类的培训资源. 对VisualWorld Bench-50K的精细调整,在VisualWorld Bench上提高了21个百分点以上,始终如一地向公众精细的识别和视觉知识基准转移.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The visual world comprises millions of fine-grained entities—species, cultivars, architectural styles, vehicle models. Yet whether current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) [ 1 , 2 ] , driven by large-scale vision-language pretraining [ 3 , 4 ] , can truly discriminate among such entities rather than merely categorize them at a coarse level remains an open question.
It can be regarded that fine-grained visual entity concepts are a form of visual world knowledge . Whether a model maintains clear discrimination boundaries among visually similar entities reflects the extent of visual world knowledge it has internalized, which underpins knowledge-intensive visual question answering and fine-grained visual reasoning.
blocks.zh:
视觉世界包括数百万个精美的实体——物种、栽培者、建筑风格、车辆模型。 然而,在大规模视觉语言预训[3,4]的推动下,目前的多式大型语言模型[1,2]能否真正在这类实体之间有所区别,而不只是在粗糙的层面上加以分类,这仍然是一个有待解决的问题。
可以认为,精致的视觉实体概念是视觉世界知识的一种形式。 一个模型在视觉类似的实体之间是否保持明显的区分界限,反映了其内在化的视觉世界知识的程度,这为知识密集型视觉问题的回答和精细的视觉推理提供了依据。

blocks.en:
However, existing benchmarks fall short along two complementary dimensions.
(1) Limited category coverage. Classic fine-grained benchmarks, such as CUB-200 [ 5 ] , Stanford Dogs [ 6 ] , and FGVC-Aircraft [ 7 ] , focus on narrow domains and limited category coverage. Even larger-scale extensions such as iNat2021 [ 8 ] and BIOSCAN-5M [ 9 ] remain largely concentrated in biological domains. Broader entity-knowledge benchmarks, including InfoSeek [ 10 ] , SimpleVQA [ 11 ] , and WorldVQA [ 12 ] , expand beyond single-domain recognition, yet still cover only a limited set of categories, falling far short of the open-ended scale of real-world visual entities.
(2) Insufficient evaluation rigor. General MLLM benchmarks such as MMBench [ 13 ] , MMMU [ 14 ] , and MMMU-Pro [ 15 ] evaluate multimodal competence rather than precise entity-level visual knowledge. Traditional fine-grained benchmarks are typically formulated as closed-set classification, which does not align with prompt-based MLLM evaluation. Meanwhile, existing entity-knowledge benchmarks often rely on task formats such as attribute QA, naming, or coarse-grained multiple-choice, where models can succeed through vague associations or elimination strategies without truly distinguishing between closely related fine-grained entities. As a result, current evaluations often fail to verify whether a model has learned precise conceptual boundaries for visual entities.
blocks.zh:
然而,现有基准在两个相辅相成的方面还不足。
(1) 有限类别覆盖面。 CUB-200 [5],斯坦福狗队 [6],和FGVC-Aircraft [7] 等经典精细分级基准,聚焦于狭窄域和有限的类别覆盖范围. 更大规模的扩展,如iNat2021[8]和BIOSCAN-5M[9],仍然主要集中于生物领域. 更广泛的实体知识基准,包括InfoSeek [10],SimpleVQA [11],以及WorldVQA [12],超越了单域识别,但仍只涵盖一组有限的类别,远远没有达到现实世界视觉实体的可扩展尺度.
(2)评价不够严格。 MMBench[13]、MMMU[14]和MMU-Pro[15]等一般MLLM基准评价多式联运能力,而不是实体一级的准确视觉知识。 传统的精细分量基准一般是作为封闭式分类制定的,这与即时的MLLM评价不一致. 同时,现有的实体知识基准往往依赖于任务格式,如属性QA,命名,或粗糙的多选择,其中模型可以通过模糊的关联或消除策略获得成功,而不真正区分密切相关的精细实体. 因此,目前的评价往往无法核实一个模型是否为视觉实体学到了准确的概念界限。

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we introduce VisualWorldBench, a taxonomy-grounded multi-task benchmark for evaluating visual world knowledge in MLLMs. Built on a taxonomy of 21,291 leaf-node classes across 8 visual domains, it comprises 32,541 evaluation instances whose ground-truth labels cover 15,479 distinct categories across the four tasks. Table 1 compares VisualWorldBench with representative prior work.
blocks.zh: 为解决这些局限性,我们引入了VisualWorld Bench,这是一个基于分类学的多任务基准,用于在MLLMs中评价视觉世界知识. 它以21 291个叶子-节点分类为基础,跨越8个视觉领域,由32 541个评价实例组成,其地面-真实标签涵盖4个任务的15 479个不同类别。 表1比较了VisualWorld Bench与前作的代表性.

blocks.en:
Our benchmark has three distinctive features.
(1) Large-scale category coverage : its ground-truth labels cover 15,479 categories across 8 visual domains, supported by a taxonomy of 21,291 leaf-node classes.
(2) Taxonomy-driven precise evaluation : most questions are constructed from taxonomically proximate categories, requiring models to distinguish precise conceptual boundaries among fine-grained entities and preventing shortcuts based on vague knowledge or elimination strategies.
(3) Comprehensive task coverage : this principle is instantiated through four complementary tasks, including text-to-image selection, image-to-text selection, target localization, and open-ended naming, covering different directions of knowledge retrieval and varying degrees of answer openness.
blocks.zh:
我们的基准有三个不同的特点。
(1) 大规模类别覆盖:其地面-真实标签涵盖8个视觉领域的15 479个类别,并由21 291个叶子-节点类的分类学支持。
(2)分类学驱动的精确评价 :大多数问题都是从分类学的相近类别中构建出来的,需要模型区分精细的受精实体之间的精确概念界限并预防基于模糊的知识或消除策略的捷径.
(3)全面任务覆盖范围:通过文字到图像选择,图像到文字选择,目标本地化,无限制命名等四个互补任务,对这一原则进行即时处理,涵盖知识检索的不同方向和不同程度的答案开放.

blocks.en:
Systematic evaluation across diverse closed-source and open-source models reveals substantial gaps in precise visual world knowledge. Large performance differences persist across task formats even within the same model family: for example, InternVL3.5-8B reaches 35.5% on closed-set recognition but only 7.4% on 3 × \times 3 localization, and similar patterns appear consistently across the Qwen, InternVL, and Gemma families. These results suggest that different task formats impose different demands on precise entity knowledge, and that closed-set accuracy alone substantially overestimates a model’s mastery of visual world knowledge.
Based on these findings, we further construct VisualWorldBench-50K, a training resource covering 50K+ categories with supervision formats aligned to the benchmark. After fine-tuning, models improve by over 21 percentage points on average on VisualWorldBench, and the gains transfer to multiple public fine-grained recognition benchmarks, including CUB-200, Stanford Dogs, and iNaturalist 2021, as well as the visual entity knowledge benchmark WorldVQA. These results demonstrate that the capability gaps exposed by VisualWorldBench are actionable and can be effectively reduced with targeted entity-level supervision. Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh:
各种封闭源码和开源模式的系统评价揭示出精确视觉世界知识的巨大差距。 即使在同一个模式家庭内,任务格式之间仍然存在巨大性能差异:例如,InternVL3.5-8B在封闭式识别上达到35.5%,但在3xx\times 3本地化上只有7.4%,在Quen、InternVL和Gemma家庭内也一致出现类似的模式。 这些结果表明,不同的任务格式对精确的实体知识提出了不同的要求,而仅仅闭合的准确性就大大地高估了模型对视觉世界知识的掌握.
根据这些调查结果,我们进一步建造了VisualWorld Bench-50K,这是一个涵盖50K+类的培训资源,其监督格式与基准一致。 经过微调后,模型在VisualWorld Bench上平均提升了超过21个百分点,收益转移到多个公共精细识别基准,包括CUB-200,斯坦福狗和iNaturalist 2021,以及视觉实体知识基准WorldVQA. 这些结果表明,VisualWorld Bench暴露出的能力差距是可以操作的,在目标实体一级的监督下可以有效减少. 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce VisualWorldBench, a taxonomy-grounded multi-task benchmark for visual world knowledge, comprising 32,541 evaluation instances with 15,479 ground-truth categories across 8 domains, built on a taxonomy of 21,291 leaf-node classes. • We propose a taxonomy-driven evaluation paradigm in which questions are constructed from taxonomically proximate categories and instantiated through four complementary task formats, enabling rigorous assessment of precise fine-grained entity knowledge. • We show that conventional closed-set evaluation substantially overestimates model capability, while more discriminative and open-ended settings expose large gaps in precise visual world knowledge; we further construct VisualWorldBench-50K, a 50K+-category training resource that improves performance on VisualWorldBench by over 21 percentage points and transfers consistently to public benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们介绍了VisualWorld Bench,这是一个基于目视世界知识的多任务分类基准,由32 541个评价实例组成,共有15 479个地面实况类别,涵盖8个领域,以21 291个叶子-节点分类为基础。 我们提出了一个分类学驱动的评价范式,在这种范式中,问题从分类学的相近类别中构建出来,并通过四个互补的任务格式进行即时分析,从而能够严格评估精确的精细实体知识。 我们显示,传统的封闭式评价大大地高估了模型能力,而更具有歧视性和开放性的环境暴露出精确的视觉世界知识的巨大差距;我们进一步构建了VisualWorld Bench-50K,即50K+类培训资源,将VisualWorld Bench的绩效提高21多个百分点,并始终按照公共基准进行转让。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Fine-grained visual recognition has been studied extensively through domain-specific classification datasets spanning birds [ 5 , 17 ] , dogs [ 6 ] , cars [ 18 , 19 ] , aircraft [ 7 ] , food [ 20 ] , flowers [ 21 ] , and pets [ 22 ] .
These datasets have driven substantial methodological progress, but they are confined to single domains with limited category counts and have become largely saturated under modern vision models.
Subsequent efforts scale category coverage: iNat2021 [ 8 ] introduces 10K biological species with a taxonomic hierarchy, and BIOSCAN-5M [ 9 ] provides millions of insect specimens for cross-modal alignment.
However, both remain within the biological domain and adopt traditional closed-set protocols rather than prompt-based evaluation.
More recently, FG-BMK [ 16 ] unifies established fine-grained datasets into MLLM-oriented question-answering and retrieval protocols, but its category coverage remains constrained by the scale of the original datasets.
blocks.zh:
细纹视觉识别通过域特有分类数据集被广泛研究,该数据集涵盖鸟类[5,17],狗[6],汽车[18,19],飞机[7],食物[20],花[21],宠物[22].
这些数据集推动了方法上的重大进展,但仅限于单一领域,类别统计有限,在现代愿景模型下已基本饱和。
随后的努力范围包括类别:iNat2021[8] 10K生物物种具有分类等级,而BIOSCAN-5M[9]为跨模式对接提供了上百万个昆虫标本.
但是,两者都属于生物领域,采用传统的封闭式协议,而不是即时评价。
最近,FG-BMK[16]将已建立的精细刻度数据集统一成以MLLM为导向的问答和检索协议,但其类别覆盖范围仍受原始数据集规模所限制.

blocks.en:
Broad-coverage MLLM benchmarks [ 13 , 14 , 23 ] have established comprehensive evaluation protocols for multimodal reasoning, but fine-grained entity recognition constitutes only a small fraction of their test suites and is not diagnosed in isolation.
A separate line of work targets visual entity knowledge directly: InfoSeek [ 10 ] and Enc-VQA [ 24 ] evaluate factual and encyclopedic knowledge about entities through question answering, yet do not assess whether models can discriminate among visually confusable alternatives or localize them spatially.
On the grounding side, referring expression comprehension [ 25 , 26 ] and grounded MLLMs [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] require localizing objects described by natural-language expressions; here, the challenge lies in resolving spatial and attribute-based ambiguity among common objects, which differs fundamentally from discriminating taxonomically adjacent fine-grained categories that share near-identical visual appearance.
blocks.zh:
宽覆盖的MLLM基准[13,14,23]已经为多模式推理建立了全面的评价协议,但精细的实体识别只占其测试套件的一小部分,没有孤立诊断.
单独的一行工作直接以视觉实体知识为目标:InfoSeek [10]和Enc-VQA [24]通过回答问题评价实体的事实和百科全书知识,但是没有评估模型是否能够区分可视相容的替代品或者在空间上将其本地化.
在地面方面,提及表达理解[25,26]和被基于的MLLMS[27,28,29],需要将自然语言表达描述的物体定位;在这方面,挑战在于解决共同物体之间的空间和属性模糊问题,这与区分具有近同视觉外观的相邻细分类别有着根本的不同。

blocks.en: 3 Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 基准

blocks.en:
The central design principle of VisualWorldBench is that all tasks share a single hierarchical taxonomy.
This structure provides taxonomy-aware distractor sampling for evaluation tasks, category-level references for quality control, and a unified framework for organizing the training resource.
We describe the taxonomy (§ 3.1 ), task design (§ 3.2 ), quality control (§ 3.3 ), and training resource (§ 3.4 ) in turn; overall benchmark statistics are provided in Appendix Table 4 .
blocks.zh:
VisualWorld Bench的中央设计原则是,所有任务都共享单一的分级分类法.
这种结构为评价任务提供了分类学-意识分心取样,为质量控制提供了类别级参考,并为组织培训资源提供了统一的框架.
我们依次介绍分类学(第3.1节)、任务设计(第3.2节)、质量控制(第3.3节)和培训资源(第3.4节);总体基准统计载于附录表4。

blocks.en: 3.1 Taxonomy and Data Sources
blocks.zh: 3.1 分类学和数据来源

blocks.en:
VisualWorldBench is built on a hierarchical taxonomy containing 21,291 leaf-node classes with a maximum depth of 14 levels (Figure 2 a), spanning 8 visual domains: animal, plant, fungus, artifact, transport, food, scene, and other.
The taxonomy is derived from the Bamboo category tree [ 30 ] and further expanded with supplementary public sources to improve category coverage across domains.
To make the taxonomy suitable for benchmark construction, we further curate both the source category set and the associated image pool through normalization, deduplication, filtering, and quality control.
After additional image-quality filtering that removes low-quality images (too dark, too small, blurry, low saturation, etc.), the released benchmark covers 15,479 ground-truth categories across all tasks while nearly all taxonomy classes appear as distractors in MCQ or Grid tasks.
Details of taxonomy construction, including per-domain class distributions and depth statistics, are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh:
视觉世界 座椅以分级分类法为基础,包含有21 291个叶子-节点类,最大深度为14级(图2a),跨越了8个视觉领域:动物、植物、真菌、文物、运输、食物、场景等。
该分类法取自"竹子类"树[30]并用补充公共来源进一步扩大,以提升分类覆盖各领域.
为了使分类学适合基准构建,我们通过正常化、分解、过滤和质量控制,进一步管理源类别集和相关图像集合。
额外的图像质量过滤可以去除低质量的图像(太暗,太小,模糊,饱和度低等)后,发布的基准覆盖了15,479个地面真实类,涵盖所有任务,而几乎所有分类类在MCQ或Grid任务中都作为分光器出现.
分类构造的细节,包括每个域的分类分布和深度统计,载于附录.

blocks.en: 3.2 Task Design
blocks.zh: 3.2 任务设计

blocks.en:
We design four task formats to probe four core capabilities: discriminating the correct category from confusable alternatives (MCQ), selecting the target image among visually similar alternatives (Grid-Sel), precisely localizing it with a bounding box (Grid-Loc), and producing its precise name without any candidate set (Open-QA).
Figure 3 illustrates representative examples of each task.
blocks.zh:
我们设计了四种任务格式,以探究四种核心能力:区分正确类别与相容替代物(MCQ),在视觉相近的替代物(Grid-Sel)中选择目标图像,精确地用边框(Grid-Loc)定位它,并在没有任何候选集(Open-QA)的情况下产生精确名称.
图3显示了每项任务的代表性实例。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Examples of the four VisualWorldBench tasks, all grounded in a shared 21,291-class taxonomy. MCQ (closed-set recognition): the model selects the correct category from 20 taxonomy-aware options (sibling, near, and random distractors). Grid-Sel / Grid-Loc (contrastive selection and precise localization): the model identifies or localizes the target category among visually similar alternatives in a composite grid. Grid-Sel requires selecting the correct cell, while Grid-Loc requires outputting a precise bounding box on the same grid layout. Open-QA (open-world naming): the model generates the fine-grained category name without any candidate set.
blocks.zh: 图3:四个VisualWorld Bench任务的例子,全部基于共享的21,291级分类学. MCQ(闭合-set识别):模型从20个分类-意识选项(同位,相近,和随机分取器)中选择正确的类别. Grid-Sel / Grid-Loc(相容选择和精确本地化):该模型在复合网格中的视觉相近替代品中识别或定位目标类别. Grid-Sel要求选择正确的单元格,而Grid-Loc要求输出一个精确的同网格布局的边框. Open-QA(开放世界命名):该模型生成细纹分类名而没有任何候选集.

blocks.en:
Each sample presents an image together with 20 candidate class names, and the model must select the single correct category.
We use 20 options, substantially more than the typical 4–5 in general-purpose benchmarks, to reduce the effect of random guessing.
Unlike standard evaluations that rely on random distractors, we construct options using hierarchical distance in the taxonomy: sibling categories share the same parent node, near categories are taxonomically close but not siblings, and random categories are sampled from farther away in the hierarchy.
Approximately 60% of distractors come from taxonomy neighbors (sibling + near), requiring fine-grained discrimination among semantically and visually related candidates (Figure 2 b).
blocks.zh:
每个样本都呈现出一幅与20个候选类名并列的图像,模型必须选择单一的正确类别.
我们使用20种选择,大大超过一般目的基准中典型的4-5,以减少随机猜测的影响。
与依赖随机分流器的标准评价不同,我们在分类学中使用分级距离构建选项:兄弟姐妹类共享同一个父节点,相近的分类是分类关系相近而非兄弟姐妹相近的,随机分类是在分级距离较远的地方进行抽样的.
大约60%的分心者来自分类学邻居(兄弟+接近),需要在与目视相关的候选人中进行精细歧视(图2b)。

blocks.en:
Grid-Sel and Grid-Loc evaluate whether a model can identify a target category when multiple visually similar alternatives are presented simultaneously in a controlled composite-image setting.
Each sample is formed by tiling the target image together with images from taxonomically similar categories into a 2 × \times 2 or 3 × \times 3 grid, with one category per cell; more than 99% of distractor cells are populated by sibling categories of the target.
Grid-Sel requires the model to identify the target cell, measuring contrastive selection ability under tightly controlled visual competition; Grid-Loc uses the same grid layouts but requires the model to output a bounding box around the target object, measuring precise localization under the same controlled setup.
The 3 × \times 3 setting is more demanding due to smaller cell images and more confusable alternatives.
blocks.zh:
Grid-Sel和Grid-Loc评价当多个视觉相近的替代品在被控制的复合图像设定中同时被呈现时,一个模型是否能够识别出目标类别.
每一个样本是通过将目标图像与分类学上相近的类别相接而成的图像相接而成的,形成一个2×分2或3×分3个网格,每个细胞有一个类别;99%以上的分心细胞被目标的兄弟类所居住.
Grid-Sel要求模型识别目标细胞,在被严格控制的视觉竞争下测量对比性选择能力;Grid-Loc使用相同的网格布局,但要求模型输出一个围绕目标对象的边框,在同一被控制的设置下测量精确的本地化.
3 ×\times 3 设置由于单元格图像更小,且可用的替代品更多而要求更高.

blocks.en: Given an image and a natural-language question (e.g., “What species of bird is this?”), the model must generate the fine-grained category name directly, with no candidate options provided.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个形象和自然语言问题(例如,“鸟类是什么种类?”),模型必须直接生成精细分类名称,不提供候选选项。

blocks.en:
MCQ and Grid-Sel are evaluated by accuracy.
Grid-Loc is evaluated by IoU@0.5 after applying a fixed bounding-box extraction and normalization procedure. Parsing and failure-handling details are provided in the appendix.
Open-QA is evaluated by EM+LLM Judge: we first match the extracted answer against the canonical label and alias set, then use a judge model to adjudicate semantically equivalent non-exact matches; full judging details are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh:
对MCQ和Grid-Sel进行精度评价.
网格-Loc由IoU@0.5在采用固定的边框取出和正常化程序后进行评价. 附录提供了解析和故障处理的细节。
Open-QA由EM+LLM Judge评价:我们首先将提取的答案与犬科标签和别名设定相匹配,然后使用一个法官模型来判定模拟等同的非精确匹配;完整的判断细节在附录中提供.

blocks.en: 3.3 Quality Control
blocks.zh: 3.3 质量控制

blocks.en: We apply a two-stage release pipeline to all tasks: annotation verification followed by release balancing and filtering .
blocks.zh: 我们对所有任务采用两阶段释放管道:说明核查,然后是释放平衡和过滤。

blocks.en:
We use three frontier closed-source models as triage signals : when at least two models produce an incorrect answer, the sample is flagged for human review.
Final keep/remove decisions follow predefined annotation criteria (label correctness, visual identifiability, ambiguity, and leakage checks) under human review; flagged samples are never removed based on model behavior alone.
We additionally conduct a random audit on non-flagged samples to ensure model-assisted triage does not miss systematic issues; details are reported in Appendix F.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们使用三个前沿闭源模型作为分解信号:当至少两个模型产生不正确的答案时,样本被标出供人类审查.
最终保存/移动决定遵循预先确定的注释标准(标签正确性、视觉识别性、模糊性、和渗漏检查);标有标记的样本从未单独根据模型行为被取出。
此外,我们还对未悬挂标记的样品进行随机审计,以确保模型辅助的分解不会错失系统性问题;详情见附录F.1。

blocks.en:
The final evaluation set is assembled from the verified pool under category-coverage, domain-representation, distractor-structure, and image-quality constraints, subject to a class-safe constraint that no category may be lost from the union of all four tasks.
Per-stage statistics, audit protocols, and detailed task-specific release rules are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh:
最终评价集从经核实的集合库中组装,属于类别覆盖,域代表,分心结构,图像质量约束,但受阶级安全制约,所有四项任务的结合不得丢失任何类别.
每个阶段的统计、审计协议和具体任务的详细发布规则载于附录。

blocks.en: 3.4 VisualWorldBench-50K
blocks.zh: 3.4 视觉世界-50K

blocks.en:
In addition to the benchmark, we construct VisualWorldBench-50K, a broader fine-grained training resource covering over 50K categories.
It is anchored by large-scale closed-set MCQ supervision and uses taxonomy-aware near-neighbor distractors to strengthen fine-grained category discrimination.
On top of this MCQ backbone, we introduce smaller amounts of grounding and open-ended supervision as complementary signals, exposing models to spatial alignment and category naming beyond closed-set recognition alone.
In total, VisualWorldBench-50K comprises approximately 7.7M training instances collected under the benchmark taxonomy from publicly available fine-grained datasets and other public image sources, with MCQ accounting for roughly 90% of records and grounding/QA each contributing approximately 5%.
As shown in Section 4 , the capability gaps exposed by VisualWorldBench can be effectively reduced through this targeted supervision.
To reduce contamination risk, we exclude Cars-196 test images and iNaturalist 2021 validation images from the training pool, as detailed in Appendix I.1 .
Its construction details and experimental use are described in Section 4 and Appendix G .
blocks.zh:
除了基准外,我们还建造了VisualWorld Bench-50K,这是一个范围更广的精细培训资源,涵盖50K多个类别。
它以大规模封闭式MCQ监督为依托,并使用近邻有分类意识的分心器来强化有细纹的类别歧视.
在这个MCQ主干线上,我们引入了较少的地平面和开放式监督作为互补信号,使模型暴露在空间对接和分类命名上,超出了仅闭塞设定的识别范围.
总体而言,VisualWorld Bench-50K包括根据基准分类法从公开的精细数据集和其他公共图像来源收集的大约7.7M培训实例,其中MCQ约占记录的90%,地面/质量保证各贡献了大约5%。
正如第4节所显示的,通过这种有针对性的监督,可以有效地缩小VisualWorld Bench暴露的能力差距。
为了减少污染风险,我们把Cos-196号车的测试图像和iNaturalist 2021验证图像排除在训练池之外,详见附录一.1。
其建筑细节和实验用途见第4节和附录G。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate three groups of models on VisualWorldBench.
(1) Closed-source models : representative frontier commercial MLLMs from Google, OpenAI, ByteDance, and Xiaomi—Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 31 ] , GPT-5.4 [ 32 ] , GPT-5.2 [ 33 ] , Doubao-Seed 2.0 Pro [ 34 ] , and Mimo-V2-Omni [ 35 ] .
(2) Open-source models : spanning four model families (Kimi, Qwen, InternVL, Gemma) across multiple parameter scales to reduce dependence on any single architecture: Kimi-K2.5 [ 36 ] , Qwen3-VL-2B/4B/8B [ 37 ] , Qwen3.5-4B/9B/27B [ 38 ] , InternVL3.5-4B/8B [ 39 ] , Gemma-4-31B, and Gemma-4-26B-A4B (MoE) [ 40 ] .
(3) SFT models : Qwen3-VL-8B/4B/2B and InternVL3.5-8B fine-tuned on VisualWorldBench-50K (Section 3.4 ) to test whether the capability gaps exposed by VisualWorldBench can be reduced through targeted fine-grained supervision.
Throughout the paper, Qwen3-VL-2B/4B/8B and InternVL3.5-8B rows without † denote the original instruct models, while rows with † denote the corresponding VisualWorldBench-50K-tuned variants.
blocks.zh:
我们在VisualWorld Bench上评价了三组模型.
(1)闭源模型:来自谷歌,OpenAI,ByteDance,和小米-Gemini 3.1 Pro [31],GPT-5.4 [32],GPT-5.2 [33],杜宝-种子2.0 Pro [34],和Mimo-V2-Omni [35]的具有代表性的前沿商业MLLMs.
(2)开源模型:跨越多参数尺度的4个模型家族(Kimi, Quen, InternVL, Gemma)来减少对任何单一架构的依赖:Kimi-K2.5 [36],Qune3-VL-2B/4B/8B [37],Quen3.5-4B/9B/27B [38], InternVL3.5-4B/8B [39], Gemma-4-31B,和Gemma-4-26B-A4B (MoE) [40].
(3) SFT型号: Qune3-VL-8B/4B/2B和InternVL3.5-8B在VisualWorld Bench-50K上进行了微调(第3.4节)以测试VisualWorld Bench所暴露的能力差距能否通过定向的精细监管来缩小.
在报纸上, Qwen3-VL-2B/4B/8B和InternVL3.5-8B行没有 QQ表示原始指示模型,而行有 QQ表示对应的VisualWorld Bench-50K调制变体.

blocks.en:
All SFT models are fine-tuned on VisualWorldBench-50K described in Section 3.4 , a broader fine-grained training resource covering over 50K classes and anchored by large-scale MCQ supervision with taxonomy-aware near-neighbor distractors.
Smaller grounding and open-ended subsets provide complementary signals beyond closed-set discrimination alone.
Training implementation details and dataset composition are provided in Appendix G .
blocks.zh:
所有SFT模型都在第3.4节所描述的VisualWorld Bench-50K上进行了微调,这是一种更广泛的精细训练资源,覆盖了50K个班级,并以大规模MCQ监督为主,使用分类学-认识近邻分光器.
更小的地基和开放式子集提供补充信号,不仅仅是封闭式歧视。
培训实施细节和数据集构成见附录G。

blocks.en:
Evaluation metrics follow the definitions in Section 3 .
Grid-Sel and Grid-Loc are evaluated at both 2 × \times 2 and 3 × \times 3 resolutions; we report both settings as well as their within-task average.
The reported overall average ( Avg ) is the arithmetic mean of MCQ, Sel Avg, Loc Avg, and Open-QA (EM+LLM Judge).
Unless otherwise stated, all models are evaluated in a zero-shot setting with greedy decoding (temperature = = 0); images are fed at each model’s native input resolution.
Additional training and evaluation details are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh:
评价尺度遵循第3节中的定义。
Grid-Sel 和 Grid-Loc 均按 2\times 2 和 3\times 3 分辨率进行评估;我们报告两种设置及其任务内平均值。
所报告的总平均值(Avg)是MCQ、Sel Avg、Loc Avg和Open-QA(EM+LLM法官)的算术平均值。
除非另有说明,所有模型都以"零发"的设定来评价,并使用贪婪的解码(温度===;图像被输入到每个模型的原生输入分辨率.
附录中提供了更多的培训和评价细节。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the main results on VisualWorldBench across closed-source models, open-source models, and our best SFT models.
blocks.zh: 表2列出了VisualWorld Bench跨闭源模型,开源模型,以及我们最好的SFT模型的主要结果.

blocks.en:
Table 2 : Main results on VisualWorldBench. MCQ : MCQ accuracy; Sel : Grid-Sel accuracy (2 × \times 2 / 3 × \times 3 / avg); Loc : Grid-Loc IoU@0.5 (2 × \times 2 / 3 × \times 3 / avg); Open : Open-QA accuracy (EM+LLM Judge); Avg : arithmetic mean of MCQ, Sel Avg, Loc Avg, and Open-QA. † Trained on VisualWorldBench-50K (Section 3.4 ).
Best result per column in bold .
blocks.zh:
表2:视觉世界奔驰的主要成果. MCQ:MCQ精度;塞尔: 网格-塞尔精度(2×时2分 / 3×时3分 / avg); Loc: Grid-Loc IoU@0.5 (2×时2分 / 3×时3分 / avg); 开口: Open-QA精度 (EM+LLM Judge); Avg: 计算平均值 MCQ, Sel Avg, Loc Avg,和 Open-QA. • 接受视觉世界Bench-50K培训(第3.4节)。
每栏最佳成绩用粗体表示。

blocks.en:
Performance varies dramatically across tasks: even models with reasonable MCQ accuracy can fail sharply on Grid-Loc.
For example, InternVL3.5-8B, InternVL3.5-4B, and Gemma-4-26B-A4B achieve only 7.4%, 8.2%, and 10.9% on Loc-3 × \times 3, despite MCQ scores of 35.5%, 33.1%, and 56.0%, respectively.
This indicates that precise localization is a systematic bottleneck for current MLLMs, and that closed-set accuracy alone substantially overestimates fine-grained capability.
The performance hierarchy is broadly consistent across the Qwen, InternVL, and Gemma families, suggesting that VisualWorldBench captures general capability differences rather than architecture-specific artifacts.
Moreover, even the best closed-source model (Gemini 3.1 Pro) reaches only 80.4% overall average, while most open-source models remain below 53%, confirming that the benchmark is far from saturated.
blocks.zh:
不同任务的性能大相径庭:即使是具有合理MCQ精度的模型也可能在Grid-Loc上急剧失败.
例如,InternVL3.5-8B,InternVL3.5-4B,和Gemma-4-26B-A4B在Loc-3 ×\time 3上只取得了7.4%,8.2%和10.9%的成绩,尽管MCQ的分数分别为35.5%,33.1%和56.0%.
这表明精确的本地化是当前MLLM的系统瓶颈,仅闭合的精度就大大地高估了精细的能力.
性能等级在Quen,InternVL,和Gemma家族之间大体一致,说明VisualWorld Bench捕捉一般能力差异而非建筑特有文物.
此外,即使是最好的闭源模型(Gemini 3.1 Pro)也只达到80.4%的总平均值,而大多数开源模型仍然低于53%,证实了基准远未饱和.

blocks.en:
Models fine-tuned on VisualWorldBench-50K achieve substantial gains, particularly on the dimensions VisualWorldBench identifies as weak.
The most striking case appears at the smallest scale: Qwen3-VL-2B † reaches 70.7% on MCQ and 45.2% on Avg, improving over its untuned counterpart by 42.7 and 25.0 percentage points and surpassing the untuned Qwen3-VL-8B instruct model (Avg 40.8%).
Gains are consistent across all three Qwen3-VL scales and InternVL3.5-8B on MCQ, Grid-Sel, and Grid-Loc alike, confirming that the gaps are not merely diagnostic but can be effectively reduced through targeted fine-grained supervision.
blocks.zh:
在VisualWorld Bench-50K上进行微调的模型,特别是在VisualWorld Bench识别为弱的维度上,取得了巨大的收益.
最引人注目的案例出现在最小的尺度上:Qwen3-VL-2B †在MCQ上达到70.7%,Avg上达到45.2%,比未对接的对应器提高了42.7%和25.0%,并超过了未对接的Qwen3-VL-8B指示模型(Avg 40.8%).
在所有三个Qune3-VL尺度和MCQ、Grid-Sel和Grid-Loc的InternVL3.5-8B尺度上,收益是一致的,这证实这些差距不仅仅是诊断性的,而是可以通过有针对性的精细监管来有效缩小。

blocks.en: 4.3 Generalization to Public Fine-Grained Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.3 普及到公共精细评分基准

blocks.en: To assess whether gains from VisualWorldBench-50K generalize beyond VisualWorldBench, we evaluate the trained models on five widely used public fine-grained MCQ benchmarks (CUB-200, Stanford Dogs, Aircraft, Flowers, Pets), iNaturalist 2021, and WorldVQA.
blocks.zh: 为了评估VisualWorld Bench-50K是否将收益概括到VisualWorld Bench之外,我们评价了经过培训的模型,这些模型涉及被广泛使用的5个公共精细度MCQ基准(CUB-200,斯坦福狗,飞机,花,宠物),iNaturalist 2021,和WorldVQA.

blocks.en:
Table 3 : Generalization to widely used public fine-grained benchmarks.
Bird–Pet: 4-option MCQ accuracy on five public fine-grained benchmarks. iNat21 : leaf-level classification accuracy on the animal and plant splits of iNaturalist 2021, plus their average. WorldVQA : open-ended visual QA accuracy (LLM-judged, structured answer format). † Trained on VisualWorldBench-50K.
blocks.zh:
表3:广泛使用公共精细分级基准的一般化。
Bird–Pet:5个公共精细分量基准上的4-选项MCQ精度. iNat21:iNaturalist 2021中动物和植物分化的叶分级精度,外加其平均值. WorldVQA : 开放式视觉QA精度(LLM-judged,结构化答案格式). * 接受视觉世界Bench-50K培训。

blocks.en:
Table 3 shows that VisualWorldBench-50K improves performance on all five public MCQ benchmarks, both iNat2021 splits, and WorldVQA across all four evaluated models.
The strongest transfer appears in the 2B setting, where public-benchmark average rises by 14.5 pp and iNat21 average by 16.2 pp; the same pattern holds at larger scales and across architectures.
These results confirm that the broad category coverage of VisualWorldBench-50K translates into consistent gains on both fine-grained recognition benchmarks and visual knowledge benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness as a general-purpose resource for improving visual world knowledge in MLLMs.
blocks.zh:
表3显示,VisualWorld Bench-50K改进了所有5个公共MCQ基准的性能,这5个基准都是iNat2021分出,而WorldVQA则在所有4个评价模型中都有所改进.
最强的转会出现在2B设置中,公共基准平均上升了14.5pp,iNat21平均上升了16.2pp;同样的模式在更大的尺度上和跨建筑上都保持.
这些结果证实,VisualWorld Bench-50K的广泛类别覆盖意味着在精细的识别基准和视觉知识基准上都取得了一致的成果,表明其作为提高MLLM中视觉世界知识的通用资源的有效性.

blocks.en: 5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 分析

blocks.en: 5.1 Domain and Depth Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 5.1 域和深度诊断

blocks.en:
Figure 4 a shows that all models perform unevenly across domains, but the profile diverges between closed-source and open-source families.
The starkest example is fungus: all open-source models score lowest in this domain (e.g., Qwen3-VL-2B 9.8%, Qwen3-VL-8B 30.4%), yet Gemini 3.1 Pro achieves 91.5%.
Within-model cross-domain gaps exceed 33 pp for Qwen3-VL-8B and 29 pp for Qwen3.5-27B, confirming that a single aggregate score can obscure important domain-specific weaknesses.
blocks.zh:
图4 a显示,所有模型在各个领域的表现不均匀,但剖面图在封闭源码和开源码家族之间存在差异。
最尖锐的例子是真菌:所有开源模型的得分都在这个域中最低(例如:Qune3-VL-2B 9.8%,Qune3-VL-8B 30.4%),然而双子座3.1 Pro却实现了91.5%.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 b shows that representative open-source models consistently degrade from intermediate depths (4–6) to the deepest levels (7+), especially in the 3 × \times 3 setting: Qwen3.5-27B drops from 67.1% to 47.9% on Grid-Sel 3 × \times 3, a decline of 19.2 pp.
Together, these domain and depth analyses show that aggregate scores mask systematic failure modes visible only under taxonomy-stratified evaluation.

blocks.en: 5.2 Transfer under Target-Label Holdout
blocks.zh: 5.2 目标标签搁置下的转让

blocks.en:
Using Qwen3-VL-2B, we randomly hold out 40% of benchmark categories and remove all SFT records whose ground-truth labels belong to these categories. On benchmark instances with held-out ground-truth labels, we compare the instruct baseline (no SFT), the holdout model (filtered SFT data), and the full model (complete SFT data).
Experimental details are provided in Appendix J .
blocks.zh:
使用Quen3-VL-2B,我们随机持有40%的基准类别,并去除所有地面真实标签属于这些类别的SFT记录. 在基准实例中,我们比较了指示基线(无SFT)、搁置模型(过滤的SFT数据)和完整的模型(完整的SFT数据)。
试验详情见附录J。

blocks.en:
Figure 4 c shows that the holdout model substantially outperforms the instruct baseline on Grid-Sel 3 × \times 3 (10.9 → \rightarrow 30.3) and Grid-Loc 3 × \times 3 (20.2 → \rightarrow 41.2), although these categories do not appear as ground-truth labels in its SFT data.
On MCQ, by contrast, the holdout model improves only modestly ( + + 7.1 pp) while the full model gains + + 42.6 pp, suggesting greater sensitivity of MCQ to the target-label holdout setting.
These results support transfer beyond categories directly supervised as SFT targets, with larger gains on selection and localization than on MCQ.
blocks.zh:
图4c显示,搁置模型大大超过了Grid-Sel 3 ×\times 3(10.9 ×\Rightarrow 30.3)和Grid-Loc 3 ×\times 3(20.2 ×\Rightar 41.2)的指令基线,尽管这些类别在其SFT数据中并不显示为地上真实的标签.
相形之下,在MCQ上,搁置模式仅略有改进(++ 7.1pp),而完整的模型增益++ 42.6pp,表明MCQ对目标标签搁置设置的敏感性更高.
这些成果支持转移,超越直接作为SFT目标监督的类别,在选择和本地化方面的收益大于MCQ。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented VisualWorldBench, a taxonomy-grounded multi-task diagnostic benchmark evaluating 15,479 ground-truth categories within a taxonomy of 21,291 leaf-node classes, together with VisualWorldBench-50K, a 50K+-category training resource. Systematic evaluation across closed-source, open-source, and fine-tuned models shows that visual world knowledge is inherently multi-dimensional: strong closed-set recognition does not imply strong contrastive selection, precise localization, or open-world naming, and these dissociations persist across model families. Under targeted supervision, fine-tuning on VisualWorldBench-50K yields substantial gains on VisualWorldBench and transfers consistently to public fine-grained recognition and visual knowledge benchmarks. Under target-label holdout, contrastive selection and localization show larger gains over the instruct baseline than closed-set recognition, supporting transfer to categories not directly supervised as SFT targets. Together, these findings suggest that visual world knowledge should be evaluated and improved as a multi-dimensional capability rather than reduced to a single recognition score.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了VisualWorld Bench,这是一个基于分类学的多任务诊断基准,在21 291个叶子-节点的分类中评估了15 479个地真相类别,以及VisualWorld Bench-50K,一个50K+类培训资源。 跨越闭源,开源,微调模型的系统评价显示视觉世界知识本质上是多维的:强闭集识别并不意味着强烈的对比性选择,精确的本地化,或开放世界命名,这些分解在模型家族中持续存在. 在目标明确的监督下,对VisualWorld Bench-50K的微调在VisualWorld Bench上取得了很大收益,并持续地转让给公众精细的识别和视觉知识基准。 在目标标签搁置下,对比性选择和本地化显示,比起封闭式设定确认,比指示基线收益更大,支持转移到不作为SFT目标直接监督的类别。 这些调查结果合在一起表明,视界知识应作为多维能力加以评价和改进,而不应降低为单一的识别分数.

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en:
Our SFT experiments focus on the Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 backbone families, so findings may not fully generalize to other architectures.
Open-QA uses EM+LLM Judge; stronger alias-aware and hierarchy-aware metrics remain future work.
Grid-Sel and Grid-Loc use controlled 2 × \times 2 / 3 × \times 3 layouts that are diagnostically useful but do not fully match natural multi-object scenes, and Grid-Loc may additionally reflect sensitivity to normalized box formatting.
The benchmark spans eight visual domains, but specialized areas such as medical imaging or satellite imagery remain under-covered.
blocks.zh:
我们的 SFT 实验侧重于 Quen3-VL 和 InternVL3.5 骨干家族,因此发现可能无法完全概括到其他建筑中去.
Open-QA使用EM+LLM判官;更强的异名感知和分级感知度量度仍然是今后的工作.
Grid-Sel和Grid-Loc使用被控制的2×\times 2 / 3×\times 3的布局,这些布局在诊断上有用,但并不完全匹配自然多对象场景,而Grid-Loc可能额外地反映对正态箱格式化的敏感性.
基准涵盖8个视觉领域,但医疗成像或卫星图像等专门领域仍然覆盖不足。

blocks.en: Appendix B Broader impacts
blocks.zh: 附录B 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: This work provides a diagnostic benchmark and training resource for fine-grained visual recognition. It can support research on species and object recognition, reveal gaps in models’ visual world knowledge, and help researchers compare capabilities across complementary tasks.
blocks.zh: 这项工作为精细的视觉识别提供了诊断基准和培训资源。 它可以支持物种和物体识别的研究,揭示模型视觉世界知识的差距,并帮助研究人员在互补的任务中比较能力.

blocks.en: Potential negative impacts arise from misidentification and over-reliance on benchmark performance. Incorrect species or object predictions could mislead users, particularly when applied to decisions such as whether a plant or fungus is safe to consume. The benchmark’s uneven domain coverage and controlled grid layouts also limit how well aggregate scores represent performance in natural settings.
blocks.zh: 可能的负面影响来自对基准业绩的误认和过度依赖。 不正确的物种或物体预测可能误导用户,特别是在对植物或真菌是否安全消费等决定适用时。 基准的不均匀域覆盖和受控网格布局也限制了总分在自然环境下的表现。

blocks.en: The benchmark is intended for research evaluation. Its scores do not establish safety or reliability for field species identification, food-safety judgments, or other consequential applications. Such uses require application-specific validation and appropriate expert review; model predictions should not serve as the sole basis for these decisions.
blocks.zh: 该基准用于研究评价。 其分数并不能确定实地物种识别、食品安全判断或其他相应应用的安全性或可靠性。 这种用途需要具体应用的审定和适当的专家审查;模型预测不应作为这些决定的唯一依据。

blocks.en: Appendix D Taxonomy Construction
blocks.zh: 附录D 分类学 建筑业

blocks.en:
The benchmark taxonomy contains 21,291 leaf-node classes across eight visual domains: animal, plant, fungus, artifact, transport, food, scene, and other.
The taxonomy is derived from the Bamboo category tree [ 30 ] and further expanded with supplementary public sources to improve category coverage across domains.
After normalization, deduplication, filtering, and manual audit over both the source category set and the associated image pool, only leaf-level categories with visually identifiable image evidence are retained as benchmark ground-truth labels.
VisualWorldBench-50K further expands category coverage beyond the benchmark taxonomy by incorporating additional public fine-grained datasets, including iNaturalist 2021.

基准分类法包含21,291个叶子-节点类,跨越了8个视觉领域:动物,植物,真菌,文物,运输,食物,场景等.
该分类法取自"竹子类"树[30]并用补充公共来源进一步扩大,以提升分类覆盖各领域.
在对源类别集和相关图像池进行正常化、分解、过滤和人工审计后,仅保留带有可视图像证据的叶子级类别作为基准地-真实标签。
VisualWorld Bench-50K将分类范围进一步扩大到基准分类法之外,增加了包括iNaturalist 2021在内的公共精细分泌数据集.

Categories are removed when they are non-visual, overly broad for fine-grained recognition, visually unverifiable from available images, or incompatible with the benchmark’s taxonomy structure.

blocks.en:
All four tasks are derived from the same taxonomy-grounded candidate pool. Public files provide task inputs, answer annotations, and domain/depth metadata, but omit construction-time category IDs and parent-category fields.

blocks.en:
Each released MCQ sample contains an image path, 20 candidate category names as strings in options , and a zero-based correct-answer index in gt_index , together with qid and domain/depth metadata.
The sibling, near, and random distinctions describe distractor construction; the simplified public files do not include per-option category IDs or type labels.
The benchmark is built by reorganizing and normalizing previously quality-checked bench pools rather than sampling directly from the full raw image archive.
For each ground-truth class, we retain at most two benchmark samples, prioritizing wider class coverage first and then applying the release-balancing rules described below.

姊妹关系,相近,和随机的区分描述分心者构造;简化的公共文件不包括每个选项类别ID或类型标签.

blocks.en:
Each Grid-Sel sample is a composite image formed by tiling one target image together with distractor images from taxonomically neighboring categories.
We construct both 2 × \times 2 and 3 × \times 3 grids.
Distractors are drawn with a sibling-first policy: we first sample direct siblings of the target from the taxonomy, and only expand to tree distance 2 when the sibling pool is insufficient.
Public Grid-Sel records provide the target category, prompt, and cell answer, but omit per-grid sibling counts and taxonomy-distance diagnostics.
Within a single grid, all source images are distinct, while exact image-set duplicates across grids are disallowed by a grid-level deduplication key.

blocks.en:
Grid-Loc shares the same composite images as Grid-Sel but changes the output space from discrete cell prediction to precise bounding-box localization.
The target bounding box is not the full target cell.
Instead, it is the target object’s bounding box after propagating the original object annotation through the crop/pad transform used to place the image into its grid cell, and then mapping that box into the coordinates of the full composite grid image.
The released benchmark stores this target box as bbox_norm , with coordinates normalized to [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] relative to the full grid image width and height.
blocks.zh:
Grid-Loc与Grid-Sel共享相同的复合图像,但将输出空间由离散细胞预测改为精确的边框本地化.
目标边框不是完整的目标单元格.
相反,它是目标对象在通过用于将图像放入其网格单元格的裁剪/平板变换来宣传原始对象的注释之后的边框,然后将该框映射入整个复合网格图像的坐标.
发布的基准将这个目标框存储为bbox_norm ,相对于全网格图像宽度和高度,坐标正常化为 [0, 1000] [0, 1000].

blocks.en:
Open-QA is derived from high-quality MCQ upstream samples rather than created independently from the raw data pool.
Public Open-QA records provide image paths, questions, alias sets, and ancestor metadata; they omit the upstream MCQ linkage field source_qid .
These metadata support exact matching, synonym handling, and future hierarchy-aware analysis, although the main paper reports only EM+LLM Judge.
blocks.zh:
Open-QA来源于高品质的MCQ上游样本,而不是从原始数据库独立创建.
公共Open-QA记录提供图像路径,问题,别名集,和祖先元数据;它们省略了上游MCQ链接域源_qid.
这些元数据支持精确匹配,同义词处理,以及未来的分级意识分析,尽管主要论文只报告EM+LLM Judge.

blocks.en:
The benchmark uses direct task-specific user prompts with constrained answer formats.
MCQ asks the model to return a single option index from 20 candidates.
Grid-Sel asks for a single cell number.
Grid-Loc requires exactly one JSON-style array [x1, y1, x2, y2] normalized to [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] .
Open-QA asks the model to identify the object as specifically as possible and place the final answer on a dedicated Answer: line.
These prompts are instantiated deterministically from the benchmark metadata and are described further in Section H .
blocks.zh:
基准使用直接针对特定任务的用户提示,有受限的回答格式.
MCQ要求模式从20名候选人中返回一个单一的选项索引.
Grid-Sel要求单个细胞号.
Grid-Loc 需要完全一个 JSON 风格的阵列 [x1, y1, x2, y2] 正常化为 [0, 1000] [0, 1100].
Open-QA要求模型尽可能具体地识别对象,并将最终答案放入一个专用的回答:行.
这些提示从基准元数据中即时确定,并在H节作进一步说明。

blocks.zh: 图6:网格任务示例(2×\times 2. (a)-(b) Grid-Sel:该模型从一个分类相似图像的复合网格中选择哪个单元格包含目标类别。 (c)-(d) Grid-Loc:该模型输出一个约束框,以精确地将目标物体定位在网格内。 红色的盒子显示地面的界限 所有分心者都是来自分类学的兄弟姐妹或接近类别.

blocks.en: Appendix F Quality Control and Curation
blocks.zh: 附录F 质量 控制和校正

blocks.en:
Each candidate sample is first evaluated by three frontier closed-source models (Gemini 3 Pro, GPT-5, GPT-4o).
These QC assistants are distinct from the evaluated model versions / endpoints in Section 4 , although some belong to the same product family (e.g., GPT-5 for QC versus GPT-5.2 / GPT-5.4 for evaluation).
Samples for which at least two of the three models produce an incorrect answer are flagged for human review.
These model outputs are used only for triage: flagged samples are not removed automatically, and final keep/remove decisions are made under predefined human criteria (label correctness, visual identifiability, ambiguity, and leakage checks).
Human annotators then assign each flagged sample to one of three outcomes: labeling error, ambiguous sample, or valid reviewed case.
Labeling errors and ambiguous samples are removed, while valid reviewed cases are retained.
blocks.zh:
每个候选样本首先由三个前沿闭源模型(Gemini 3 Pro,GPT-5,GPT-4o)进行评审.
这些QC助手与第4节中被评价的模型版本/端点不同,虽然有些属于同一个产品家族(例如QC的GPT-5与GPT-5.2/GPT-5.4的评价).
三个模型中至少有两个给出错误答案的样本被标出供人类审查。
这些模型输出只用于分解:标有标记的样本不会被自动取出,最后的保存/移出决定是根据预先定义的人类标准(标签正确性,可视化性,模糊性,和渗漏检查)作出的.
然后,人类注释者将每个标出样本分配给三个结果中的一个:标签错误、模棱两可的样本或经过审查的有效案例。
标记错误和模棱两可的样本被删除,而有效的审查案例被保留。

blocks.en: F.1 Audit of Non-flagged Samples
blocks.zh: F.1 对无标记样本的审计

blocks.en:
To test whether model-assisted triage systematically misses problematic samples that most assisting models answer correctly, we additionally conduct a random human audit on non-flagged samples from each task.
The audit is performed under the same criteria as the main verification pass and is used only to assess the robustness of the QC pipeline, not to redefine the benchmark.
Table 9 reports the audit protocol and issue rates.
blocks.zh:
为了测试模型辅助分解是否系统地忽略了大多数辅助模型正确回答的有问题的样本,我们还对每项任务的无标记样本进行了随机的人类审计。
审计工作按照与主要核查证相同的标准进行,只用于评估质量控制程序是否健全,而不是重新界定基准。
表9报告审计协议和发行率。

blocks.en:
For Grid-Sel and Grid-Loc, verification is performed at the per-cell level to ensure that each grid cell matches its assigned category.
Samples are removed if the target object occupies less than 1% of the image area, if the grid composition is visually corrupted, or if the target category is not visually distinguishable from the distractor cells.
Grid-Loc uses the same composite-image pool as Grid-Sel after alignment, but applies the IoU@0.5 evaluation threshold.
blocks.zh:
对于Grid-Sel和Grid-Loc,在每个细胞层面进行校验,以确保每个网格单元格符合其指定类别.
如果目标对象占据的图像区域不到1%,如果网格构成被视觉腐蚀,或者如果目标类别与分散细胞无法视觉区分,则取出样本.
Grid-Loc在对齐后使用与Grid-Sel相同的复合图像池,但应用了IoU@0.5评价阈值.

blocks.en:
Open-QA candidates are filtered in two stages.
First, samples whose ground-truth categories are not visually identifiable are removed.
Second, a frontier model performs visual quality inspection for image quality, text leakage, identifiability, and ground-truth correctness; only samples receiving a KEEP verdict are retained.
blocks.zh:
开放式质量评估候选人分两个阶段过滤。
首先,将地面真相类别无法识别的样品取出。
第二,前沿模型对图像质量、文本泄漏、可识别性和地面真实性进行视觉质量检查;只保留收到KEEP判断的样本。

blocks.en: Table 8 : Quality-control statistics. The Release pool column reports the count after the task-specific intermediate filtering stage (release balancing for MCQ and Grid-Sel, visual QC for Grid-Loc and Open-QA) but before the final image-quality filter. The Final column reports the count after the additional automated image-quality filter.
blocks.zh: 表8:质量控制统计。 发布池栏在任务特定中间过滤阶段后(为MCQ和Grid-Sel的放出平衡,为Grid-Loc和Open-QA的视觉QC)报告计数,但在最终图像质量过滤之前. 最后一栏在额外的自动图像质量过滤器后报告计数.

blocks.en:
Table 9 : Random audit of non-flagged samples.
200 samples per task are drawn uniformly at random from the non-flagged pool (seed = 42) and reviewed under the same criteria as the main verification pass. Issue : any sample requiring correction or removal because of label error, ambiguity, non-identifiability, leakage, or corrupted composition.
blocks.zh:
表9:无标记样品的随机审计。
每个任务200个样本由无悬挂标记的池(种子=42个)随机统一抽取,按照与主核查证相同的标准审查. 问题:由于标签出错、模糊不清、无法识别、渗漏或成分被腐蚀而需要更正或删除的任何样本。

blocks.en: Response-pattern labels are derived from frontier-model outputs and used only as QC / audit metadata for identifying potentially problematic samples for additional review. They are not release-construction criteria, stand-alone validity criteria, or the basis for defining benchmark difficulty.
blocks.zh: 反应式标签取自前沿模式产出,仅用作质量控制/审计元数据,用于确定可能存在问题的样本,供进一步审查。 它们不是释放建造标准、独立的有效性标准,也不是确定基准难度的依据。

blocks.en:
MCQ release construction. For MCQ, we begin the final release stage from an intermediate pool of 22,356 samples that already satisfies the main verification and release-balancing constraints.
Importantly, samples are not removed simply because reference models answer them correctly; rather, model disagreement and repeated failure patterns are used only to trigger additional human verification for potentially problematic cases.
We then apply a final automated image-quality filter that removes visually unreliable images (too dark, too small, blurry, low saturation), yielding 14,717 released MCQ samples.
blocks.zh:
MCQ发布建设. 就MCQ而言,我们从22 356个样本的中间池开始最后释放阶段,这些样本已经满足主要的核查和放出平衡限制。
重要的是,样本不会仅仅因为参考模型正确回答而被取出;相反,模型的分歧和重复的失败模式只是用来引发对潜在有问题的案件的额外的人类核查。
然后,我们应用一个最终的自动图像质量过滤器,取出视觉上不可靠的图像(太暗,太小,模糊,饱和度低),产生14,717个释放的MCQ样本.

blocks.en: Grid-Sel release construction follows the same principle: final release balancing is carried out over verified samples while jointly considering distractor structure, domain coverage, and visual quality, followed by five-dimension visual QC (target-cell quality, text leakage, distinguishability, ground-truth correctness, overall verdict) using dual frontier models (Gemini 3 Pro primary, GPT-5 fallback), retaining only KEEP samples.
blocks.zh: Grid-Sel释放构建遵循了同样的原则:在经过核实的样本上进行最终释放平衡,同时联合考虑分心结构,域覆盖和视觉质量,再用双前沿模型(Gemini 3 Pro Prime,GPT-5倒置)进行五分光视觉QC(目标-细胞质量,文本泄漏,可辨别性,地真相正确性,整体判断),只保留KEEP样本.

blocks.en: Grid-Loc is evaluated on the same composite images as Grid-Sel after alignment; the IoU@0.5 threshold follows the standard used in visual grounding benchmarks.
blocks.zh: Grid-Loc在对齐后在与Grid-Sel相同的复合图像上被评价;IoU@0.5阈值遵循了视觉地平线基准中使用的标准.

blocks.en:
Open-QA. Three frontier models (Gemini 3 Pro, GPT-5, GPT-4o) independently attempt each question via exact match.
These outputs define three auxiliary response-pattern buckets: full_consensus (3/3 correct), partial_consensus (1–2/3 correct), and zero_consensus (0/3 correct).
These buckets are retained only as auxiliary audit metadata; the released set is assembled from verified samples under domain filtering (removing categories with non-visual ground truths), the same five-dimension visual QC as Grid, and automated image-quality filtering, yielding 2,209 samples.
blocks.zh:
开放QA. 三种边疆模型(Gemini 3 Pro,GPT-5,GPT-4o)通过精确的匹配,独立尝试每个问题.
这些输出定义了三个辅助响应-平板桶:full_Consensus (3/3正确),part-Consensus (1–2/3正确)和0-Consensus (0/3正确).
这些活桶仅保留为辅助审计元数据;所放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放放

blocks.en: F.2 Sanity Check on Model-Assisted QC
blocks.zh: F.2 模型化QC的敏感性检查

blocks.en:
By design, the frontier models used for annotation triage and QC (Gemini 3 Pro, GPT-5, GPT-4o) are version-distinct from the evaluated model endpoints in Section 4 , eliminating direct circular dependence between curation and evaluation at the deployed-model level.
These model outputs are used to identify samples that require additional verification; they are not used as automatic deletion rules for samples answered correctly by the assisting models.
As additional evidence that the main findings are not artifacts of any particular assisting model family, Table 10 confirms that the cross-task capability dissociations (large MCQ–Open and MCQ–Loc gaps) persist across diverse closed-source, open-source, and SFT model families.
blocks.zh:
设计上,用于注释分解和QC的前沿模型(Gemini 3 Pro,GPT-5,GPT-4o)与第4节中被评价的模型端点是版本相去甚远的,消除了在已部署的模型层面的分解与评价之间的直接循环依赖.
这些模型输出用于识别需要额外核查的样本;它们不作为辅助模型正确回答的样本的自动删除规则.
作为其他证据,主要结论不是任何特定援助模式家庭的文物,表10证实跨任务能力脱钩(大型MCQ–Open和MCQ–Loc差距)在多种封闭源码、开放源码和SFT模式家庭仍然存在。

blocks.en:
Table 10 : Sanity check: cross-task capability dissociations across model families. MCQ–Open : difference between closed-set MCQ accuracy and Open-QA accuracy. MCQ–Loc : difference between MCQ accuracy and Grid-Loc 3 × \times 3 accuracy.
Large gaps persist across all families, confirming that the dissociations are general rather than artifacts of any assisting model.
blocks.zh:
表10: 卫生检查:示范家庭跨任务能力分离. MCQQOpen:闭合集MCQ精度与Open-QA精度之差. MCQQLoc:MCQ精度与Grid-Loc 3×\times 3精度之差.
所有家庭之间仍然存在巨大差距,这证明脱离关系是一般现象,而不是任何援助模式的文物。

blocks.en: Appendix G Training Details
blocks.zh: 附录G 培训 细节

blocks.en:
All SFT models are trained with LoRA in LLaMA-Factory [ 41 ] for 3 epochs using AdamW, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and an effective global batch size of 1024.
Unless otherwise stated, we use LoRA [ 42 ] with rank 8 and target all trainable modules.
VisualWorldBench-50K is anchored by large-scale closed-set MCQ supervision, with a reasoning-augmented MCQ subset and smaller grounding and open-ended QA subsets providing complementary signals.
blocks.zh:
所有SFT模型都与LORA一起接受LLaMA-Factory[41]的培训,培训对象为使用AdamW的3个纪元,学习率10−4 10^{-4},有效的全球批量尺寸为1024.
除非另有说明,否则我们使用第8级的LORA[42]并瞄准所有可训练的模块.
VisualWorld Bench-50K由大规模闭合集MCQ监制而成,有推理增强的MCQ子集和更小的地平面和开放式QA子集提供互补信号.

blocks.en: Table 11 : VisualWorldBench-50K composition. The resource is dominated by MCQ supervision; reasoning-augmented MCQ is a subset of the MCQ records rather than an additional disjoint pool.
blocks.zh: 表11:视觉世界Bench-50K成分. 资源以MCQ监督为主;推理增强的MCQ是MCQ记录的一个子集,而不是额外的脱节集合.

blocks.en:
For each SFT model, we inspect late-stage checkpoints to confirm convergence and report one representative converged checkpoint in the main paper.
Table 12 summarizes the compute used by the four main SFT runs. Compute usage for the holdout run is not reported separately.
The 2B run used per-device batch size 64 and gradient accumulation 2 on 8 H200 GPUs; for the 4B and 8B runs, we adjusted the per-device batch size and accumulation settings to keep the same effective global batch size.
blocks.zh:
对于每个SFT模式,我们检查后期检查站,以确认趋同之处,并在主要文件中报告一名代表聚集的检查站。
表12汇总了四大SFT运行所使用的计算. 暂停运行的计算用途不单独报告。
2B跑在8个H200GPU上使用了每设备批量64和梯度积分2;对于4B和8B跑,我们调整了每设备批量大小和积分设置,以保持相同的有效全球批量大小.

blocks.en: Table 12 : Compute resources for the main Qwen3-VL SFT, InternVL3.5 SFT runs. GPU-hours are computed as wall-clock hours multiplied by the number of GPUs.
blocks.zh: 表12:计算主要Quen3-VL SFT,InternVL3.5 SFT运行的资源. GPU-小时数按墙上小时数乘以GPU数来计算.

blocks.en: Appendix H Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录H 评价详情

blocks.en:
Benchmark evaluation uses zero-shot prompting with greedy decoding.
MCQ and Grid-Sel are scored by accuracy, Grid-Loc uses IoU@0.5 following the standard threshold in visual grounding benchmarks [ 25 , 26 , 43 ] , and Open-QA uses EM+LLM Judge.
Grid-Sel and Grid-Loc are evaluated at both 2 × \times 2 and 3 × \times 3 resolutions; we report both settings as well as their within-task average.
For the reported average score, we take the arithmetic mean of MCQ, Sel Avg (mean of 2 × \times 2 and 3 × \times 3), Loc Avg (mean of 2 × \times 2 and 3 × \times 3), and Open-QA under EM+LLM Judge.
blocks.zh:
基准评价使用以贪婪的解码来进行零镜头提示.
MCQ和Grid-Sel通过精度得分,Grid-Loc使用IoU@0.5在视觉地基基准上遵循标准阈值[25,26,43],Open-QA使用EM+LLM Judge.
Grid-Sel 和 Grid-Loc 均按 2\times 2 和 3\times 3 分辨率进行评估;我们报告两种设置及其任务内平均值。
对于报告的平均分数,我们采用MCQ,Sel Avg的算术平均值(平均值为2×时2分和3×时3分),Loc Avg(平均值为2×时2分和3×时3分),以及EM+LLM裁判下的Open-QA.

blocks.en:
MCQ uses a prompt that presents the image together with 20 indexed candidate categories and instructs the model to output only the selected index.
Grid-Sel uses a prompt of the form: “You are given a N × N N{\times}N grid image. Cells are numbered left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Which cell contains the target category: {class_name} ?” and requires a single-number answer.
Grid-Loc uses a localization prompt that asks the model to return exactly one bounding box in the format [x1, y1, x2, y2] .
The coordinate convention is normalized to [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] relative to the full composite image, where ( 0 , 0 ) (0,0) is the top-left corner and ( 1000 , 1000 ) (1000,1000) is the bottom-right corner.
Open-QA asks the model to identify the object as specifically as possible, provide one brief evidence sentence, and then output the final prediction on a new line as Answer: <category name> .
blocks.zh:
MCQ使用一个提示来显示图像和20个索引候选类别,并指示模型只输出所选索引.
Grid-Sel使用一个表单的提示:“你得到一个N × N\ Times}N格子图像。 单元格由左到右,由上到下编号. 哪个单元格包含目标类别 : {class_name}?} 并且需要单数答案 。
Grid-Loc 使用本地化提示,该提示要求模型返回格式 [x1, y1, x2, y2] 中一个精确的边框 。
坐标会同相对完整复合相片的正统为[0,1000][0,1000],其中(0,0)为左上角,(1000,1000)为右下角.
Open-QA要求模型尽可能具体地识别对象,提供一个简短的证据句子,然后在一行新线上输出出最后的预测作为Answer:<分类名称>.

blocks.zh: H.1 快速模板

blocks.en:
Below we provide the exact prompt templates used for each task.
Placeholders are shown in {braces} .
All prompts are zero-shot with no system prompt.

下面我们提供每项任务所用的准确的即时模板。
占位符显示于{braces}.
所有提示都是零发而无系统提示.

blocks.en: MCQ Prompt Look at the object(s) in the image and choose the single best category from 1-{N}. Only output the number. 1: {option_1} 2: {option_2} ⋮ 20: {option_20}

blocks.en: Grid-Sel Prompt You are given a {N}x{N} grid image. Cells are numbered left-to-right, top-to-bottom as 1, 2, …, {N × \times N}. Which cell contains the target category: {class_name}? Answer with a single number. Do not output any other text.
blocks.zh: 网格- 塞尔提示 您被赋予了 {N}x{N} 网格图像 。 单元格被编号为从左到右, 从上到下为 1, 2,..., {N ×\times N}。 哪个单元格包含目标类别 : { class_ name} ? 以一数答. 不输出其它文本 。

blocks.en: Grid-Loc Prompt Locate the target object: {class_name}. Output the bounding box as [x1, y1, x2, y2] where: - (x1, y1) = top-left corner - (x2, y2) = bottom-right corner - Coordinates normalized to [0, 1000] (0=left/top edge, 1000=right/bottom edge) Example: [100, 200, 500, 800] Output only the four numbers in brackets. Return exactly one bounding box for the target object. Your entire reply must be exactly one single-line JSON array: [x1, y1, x2, y2] Rules: - Output exactly one JSON array with four numeric coordinates. - Coordinates must be normalized to [0,1000]. - Do not output markdown, code fences, labels, keys, comments, explanations, prefixes, or suffixes. - Do not output multiple boxes, alternatives, candidate answers, or reasoning. - If uncertain, still output your single best box in the required format.
blocks.zh: 网格- loc 提示 定位目标对象 : {class_name}. 输出边框为 [x1, y1, x2, y2], 其中: --(x1, y1) = 左上角 - (x2, y2) = 右下角 - 坐标正常化为 [0, 1000] (0=左上边缘, 1000=右下边缘) 示例:[100、200、500、800] 只输出括号内的四个数字。 为目标对象返回一个精确的边框。 您的整个回复必须完全是一个单行 JSON 阵列: [x1, y1, x2, y2] 规则: - 输出完全一个 JSON 阵列, 并带有四个数字坐标 。 -坐标必须正常化为 [0,100]. - 不要输出标记下,代码栅栏,标签,键,注释,解释,前缀,或后缀. 不输出多个框、 选项、 候选答案或推理 。 - 如果不确定, 仍以规定格式输出您的单个最佳框 。

blocks.en: Open-QA Prompt Identify the object in the image as specifically as possible. {question} First give one brief sentence describing the key visual evidence. Then give the final answer on a new line in the format: Answer: <category name> Keep the evidence brief. Do not add anything after the answer line.
blocks.zh: 打开QA 提示 尽可能具体地识别图像中的对象。 [问] 首先,简短地说出关键的视觉证据。 然后在格式的新行上给出最后的答案: 回答: " 类别名称 " 举出证据 回答行后不要添加任何内容。

blocks.en:
Notes. (1) MCQ options are numbered starting from 1; the model is expected to output a single integer.
(2) Grid-Sel and Grid-Loc share the same composite grid image; only the output format differs (cell index vs. bounding box).
(3) Grid-Loc coordinates follow the [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] normalization convention where ( 0 , 0 ) (0,0) is the top-left and ( 1000 , 1000 ) (1000,1000) is the bottom-right of the full composite image.
(4) In Open-QA, {question} is the question provided with each sample and uses domain-aware phrasing (e.g., “What kind of bird/flower/fungus…”) to elicit fine-grained category-level responses rather than coarse object descriptions.
blocks.zh:
注释。 (1)MCQ选项从1开始编号;预计该模型输出出单个整数.
(2)Grid-Sel和Grid-Loc共享相同的复合网格图像;只有输出格式不同(细胞索引与边框).
(3)网格-Loc坐标跟随 [0,1000] [0,1100] 正常化公约,其中(0,0)为左上角,(1000,1000,1000)为全复合图像的右下角.
(4) 在Open-QA中,{ question}是提供每个样本的问题,并使用有域意识的用词(如"哪一种鸟/花/fungus.")来引出细纹的分类级响应,而不是粗糙的物体描述.

blocks.en:
For MCQ and Grid-Sel, a valid discrete answer index is extracted from the model response using fixed parsing rules and compared with the ground-truth index. Responses from which a valid index cannot be extracted are scored as incorrect.
For Grid-Loc, the evaluator searches the response for bracketed sequences of four numbers and uses the first matching sequence as the predicted box; surrounding explanatory text is permitted.
If no bracketed sequence is found, the evaluator falls back to the first four numeric values in the response.
Coordinates are clipped to [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] , and reversed coordinate pairs are reordered along each axis.
The resulting box is compared against the stored normalized target box using IoU@0.5.
Responses from which four numeric values cannot be extracted are treated as parsing failures.
For Open-QA, the evaluator extracts the final answer line, normalizes the resulting string, applies exact matching against the canonical label and alias set, and forwards only non-exact cases to the LLM judge.
blocks.zh:
对于MCQ和Grid-Sel,从模型响应中取出一个有效的离散解答指数,使用固定解析规则,并与地-实指数作比较. 无法提取有效指数的答复被评为不正确。
对于Grid-Loc,评价人员搜索四个数字的括号序列的响应,并使用第一个匹配序列作为预测框;周围的解释文本是允许的.
如果没有找到括号内的序列,评估者会回落到反应中前四个数值.
坐标被剪接到 [0,1000] [0,100],倒转坐标对沿每个轴重排.
生成的框与所存储的正态目标框相比较,使用IoU@0.5.
无法从中取出4个数值的回复被视为解析失败。
对于"Open-QA",评价者取出最终的答案行,使由此产生的字符串正常化,对"犬"的标签和所设定的别名进行精确匹配,并仅将非准确的案件转交LLM法官.

blocks.en:
All reported results use greedy decoding with temperature 0 0 .
The benchmark prompts do not rely on separate task-specific system prompts.
For Grid-Loc, parsing failures among records not marked as request errors receive an IoU of zero and remain in the accuracy denominator.
Records marked as request errors are counted separately and excluded from the accuracy denominator.
Multiple-box responses are scored using the first extracted box and are additionally recorded in the multiple-box statistics.
blocks.zh:
所有报告的结果都使用0 温度的贪婪解码。
基准提示不依赖单独的任务特定系统提示.
对于Grid-Loc,在未被标记为请求错误的记录中解析失败,得到的IoU为0并保留在准确分母中.
标为请求错误的记录单独计数,从准确分母中排除.
多框响应使用第一个取出框来打分,并额外被记录在多框统计中.

blocks.en: H.2 Open-QA Judging
blocks.zh: H.2 开放式质量判断

blocks.en:
Open-QA answers are scored in three stages.
We first extract the model’s final answer string, then match it against the canonical label and alias set.
For non-exact matches, a fixed frontier LLM judge (Gemini 2.5 Pro) is used to decide whether the prediction is semantically equivalent to the gold category, including capitalization differences, common-name/scientific-name variants, and accepted synonyms; this follows recent LLM-as-a-judge evaluation practice [ 44 , 45 ] .
The judge is instructed not to accept predictions that only name a parent category or a visually similar sibling category.
blocks.zh:
Open-QA解答分出分出三个阶段.
我们先取出模型的最后的答案字符串,然后与标语和别名相匹配.
对于非精确匹配,使用固定边疆LLM裁判(Gemini 2.5 Pro)来决定预测是否与金矿类等同,包括资本化差异,同名/科学名变体,以及被接受的同名词;这遵循了最近的LLM-as-a-judge评价惯例[44,45].
法官奉命不接受只取出父母类别或视同兄弟类别的预测。

blocks.en: Open-QA Judge Prompt (System) You are a taxonomy and fine-grained recognition expert. Your task: determine whether a model’s prediction refers to the SAME specific species/object as the ground truth. Be strict --- only judge "correct" if they refer to the exact same species or object (synonyms, common name variants, and minor spelling differences are acceptable). If the prediction is at a coarser level (e.g., genus instead of species, or "bird" instead of "American Robin"), judge "wrong".
blocks.zh: 公开质量保证法官即时(系统) 你是一个分类学和精细的识别专家。 您的任务: 确定一个模型的预测是否将 SAME 特定物种/对象作为地面真理 。 要严格————只有判断"正确",如果它们指的正是同一个物种或对象(同义词,同名变体,和小的拼写差异是可以接受的). 如果预测处于相近水平(如:基因代替物种,或"鸟"代替"美国罗宾"),判断"错误".

blocks.en: Open-QA Judge Prompt (User) Ground truth: {gt_name} Accepted aliases: {aliases} Model’s prediction: {pred_text} Does the model’s prediction refer to the same specific species/object as the ground truth? Output exactly one JSON object (no other text): {"judgment": "correct" or "wrong", "reason": "one sentence explanation"}
blocks.zh: Open-QA 判事( 用户) 地面真伪 : {gt_ name} 接受别名 : {aliases} 模型预测 : {pred_ text} 该模型的预测是否将同一特定物种/对象作为地面真理? 输出一个 JSON 对象( 没有其他文本 ): {"判断":"正确"或"错误","理由":"一个句子解释"}

blocks.en: Only samples that fail automated exact matching against the canonical label and alias set are forwarded to the LLM judge; exact matches are scored directly without an API call.
blocks.zh: 只有那些无法自动准确匹配与犬科标签和别名设定的样本才会被转发给LLM裁判;准确匹配直接被打入而无需API呼叫.

blocks.en:
Table 13 : Open-QA judge validation on Doubao-Seed-2.0-pro predictions.
We sample 200 Gemini 2.5 Pro judge decisions (100 accept, 100 reject) on Open-QA predictions produced by Doubao-Seed-2.0-pro uniformly at random (seed = 42) and independently re-evaluate them with a human annotator. Precision : fraction of judge-accepted predictions that are truly correct. Recall : fraction of truly correct predictions that the judge accepts. Cohen’s κ \kappa follows the standard inter-rater agreement coefficient [ 46 ] .
blocks.zh:
表13:杜宝-种子-2.0-pro预测的Open-QA法官验证.
我们抽取了200个双子座 2.5 Pro 评断(100个接受,100个拒绝)对杜宝-种子-2.0-pro随机生成的Open-QA预测(种子=42)做出的判决,并以人名注释员独立地重新评价. 精度:法官所接受的确实正确的预测的一小部分. 回顾:法官接受的真正正确预测的一小部分。 Cohen's $\kappa 遵循了标准方间协议系数[46].

blocks.en: Appendix I Additional Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录一 其他分析

blocks.en: I.1 Data Integrity
blocks.zh: 一. 导言 数据完整性

blocks.en:
Source datasets are filtered before training: (i) Cars-196 test images and (ii) iNaturalist 2021 validation images are removed wholesale from the training pool, since these images appear (or may appear) in standard public evaluation splits.
Category overlap, by contrast, is intrinsic to the benchmark design: VisualWorldBench-50K and VisualWorldBench are intended to cover the same fine-grained recognition space, so they are not category-disjoint.
We therefore treat image-level overlap as the relevant leakage criterion, while the holdout experiment (Appendix J ) probes transfer to categories excluded from SFT target labels.
blocks.zh:
源数据集在培训前被过滤出: (一)汽车-196测试图像和 (二)iNaturalist 2021验证图像被批发地从培训池中去除,因为这些图像出现在(或可能出现在)标准公共评价分出.
相比之下,类别重叠是基准设计的固有内容: VisualWorld Bench-50K和VisualWorld Bench旨在覆盖同一种精细的识别空间,因此它们不是类相离.
因此,我们把图像水平重叠作为相关的泄漏标准,而搁置实验(Appendix J)探测器则转移至SFT目标标签所排除的类别.

blocks.en: Appendix J Holdout Experiment Details
blocks.zh: 附录J 搁置 实验细节

blocks.en: J.1 Experiment Design
blocks.zh: J.1 实验设计

blocks.en:
We investigate whether fine-grained SFT improves performance on categories that are not directly supervised as SFT targets.
For this target-label holdout experiment, we randomly hold out 40% of benchmark categories (seed = 42) and remove all SFT training samples whose ground-truth label belongs to the held-out set.
We then compare three conditions on the subset of VisualWorldBench instances whose ground-truth category falls within the held-out set:
blocks.zh:
我们调查精细的SFT是否改善那些没有作为SFT目标直接监督的类别的业绩.
对于这个目标标签搁置实验,我们随机持有40%的基准类别(种子=42),并取出所有SFT训练样本,其地上真实标签属于搁置的一组.
然后,我们比较了VisualWorld Bench案例子集的三个条件,这些案例的地真相属于被搁置的范畴:

blocks.en: 1. Instruct baseline : Qwen3-VL-2B without any fine-grained SFT. 2. Holdout model : Qwen3-VL-2B fine-tuned on the filtered VisualWorldBench-50K (records with held-out ground-truth labels removed). 3. Full model : Qwen3-VL-2B fine-tuned on the complete VisualWorldBench-50K (all categories included).
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 指示基线 : Quen3-VL-2B 没有任何精细的 SFT. 2. Holdout 型号:在被过滤的VisualWorld Bench-50K上对Qune3-VL-2B进行了微调(删除了被持有的地上真实标签的记录)。 3. 完整型号:Qune3-VL-2B 在完整的VisualWorld Bench-50K上进行了微调(包括所有类别)。

blocks.en: Instruct baseline : Qwen3-VL-2B without any fine-grained SFT.
blocks.zh: 指示基线 : Quen3-VL-2B 没有任何精细的 SFT.

blocks.en: Holdout model : Qwen3-VL-2B fine-tuned on the filtered VisualWorldBench-50K (records with held-out ground-truth labels removed).
blocks.zh: Holdout 型号:被过滤的VisualWorld Bench-50K上被精制出Quen3-VL-2B(已删除被持有的地上真实标签的记录).

blocks.en: Full model : Qwen3-VL-2B fine-tuned on the complete VisualWorldBench-50K (all categories included).
blocks.zh: 完整型号: Quen3-VL-2B 在完整的VisualWorld Bench-50K上进行了微调(所有类别都包括在内).

blocks.en: Gains over the instruct baseline measure improvement on categories absent from the SFT target labels. This split controls target-label supervision during SFT; it does not establish absence from pretraining or from other roles such as distractors in the SFT data. Full-versus-holdout comparisons also differ in training-data volume, so they do not isolate the effect of category-specific supervision.
blocks.zh: 指示基线衡量方法在SFT目标标签中缺失的类别方面的改进。 这种分解控制目标标签监管在SFT期间;它并不证明不存在预训或SFT数据中分心器等其他角色. 全控比较与全控比较在培训数据量上也有所不同,因此它们不会孤立特定类别监督的效果.

blocks.en: J.2 Training Data Filtering
blocks.zh: J.2 培训数据过滤

blocks.en:
Starting from VisualWorldBench-50K ( ∼ \sim 7.69M records after the source-level filtering described in Appendix I.1 ), we remove all records whose ground-truth label matches the held-out category set.
Table 14 reports the per-format filtering statistics.
blocks.zh:
从VisualWorld Bench-50K(\\sim 7.69M记录,在附录一.1所描述的源级过滤后)开始,我们删除所有其地面-真实标签与被搁置类别相匹配的记录。
表14报告每个格式的过滤统计。

blocks.en:
Table 14 : Training data filtering for the holdout experiment.
Records are removed when their ground-truth label belongs to the held-out category set.
blocks.zh:
表14:为搁置试验进行的培训数据过滤。
记录在属于被搁置类别时被删除。

blocks.en:
A post-hoc audit confirms that no held-out category appears among the ground-truth labels of the filtered SFT data.
The overall removal rate (25.1%) is lower than the holdout ratio (40%) because a large proportion of training categories are not present in the benchmark and are therefore fully retained.
blocks.zh:
一项事后审计证实,在经过过滤的SFT数据的地上真实标签中,不存在搁置类别。
总的去除率(25.1%)低于拒发率(40%),因为很大一部分培训类别没有列入基准,因此完全保留。

blocks.en: J.3 Evaluation Subset
blocks.zh: J.3 评价分集

blocks.en:
We evaluate on released-benchmark instances whose ground-truth labels fall into the held-out category set.
After intersecting the held-out category set with the released benchmark splits, the evaluation subsets contain 5,729 MCQ samples, 1,653 Grid-Sel 3 × \times 3 samples, and 1,377 Grid-Loc 3 × \times 3 samples.
All three tasks use the same curated benchmark splits and scoring metrics as the main results table (IoU@0.5 for Grid-Loc).
blocks.zh:
我们评价那些属于被搁置类别、其地面真实标签属于被搁置类别的情况。
在将设定的被搁置类别与释放的基准分出相交叉后,评价子集包含5,729个MCQ样本,1,653个Grid-Sel 3 ×\times 3个样本,1,377个Grid-Loc 3 ×\times 3个样本.
所有这三项任务都使用与主结果表相同的被整理的基准分数和评分指标(IoU@0.5 for Grid-Loc).

blocks.en: J.4 Results
blocks.zh: J.4 结果

blocks.en: Table 15 reports the three-condition comparison on the held-out evaluation subset.
blocks.zh: 表15报告了对搁置评价子集的三个条件的比较。

blocks.en:
Table 15 : Holdout experiment results on held-out categories.
All numbers are percentages evaluated on released-benchmark instances whose ground-truth labels belong to the held-out category set. Δ H-B \Delta_{\text{H-B}} : holdout model gain over instruct baseline.
blocks.zh:
表15:搁置类别试验结果。
所有数字都是在地面真实标签属于被搁置类别的释放基准实例上评价的百分比。 H-B\Delta\text{H-B}:搁置模型比指示基线增益。

blocks.en:
The holdout model achieves substantial gains over the instruct baseline on Grid-Sel 3 × \times 3 ( + + 19.4 pp) and Grid-Loc 3 × \times 3 ( + + 21.0 pp), although these categories do not appear as ground-truth labels in its SFT data.
On Grid-Sel 3 × \times 3, the holdout model reaches 30.3%, close to the full model’s 31.3%, showing a similar selection gain when these categories are excluded from SFT target labels.
On Grid-Loc, the full model retains a clear advantage (51.6% vs. 41.2%), while the holdout model still improves substantially over the instruct baseline.
blocks.zh:
搁置模式比Grid-Sel 3 ×\times 3(+ 19.4 pp)和Grid-Loc 3 ×\times 3(+ + 21.0 pp)的指令基线大有收获,尽管这些类别在其SFT数据中并不显示为地上真实的标签.
在Grid-Sel 3×\times 3上,搁置模式达到30.3%,接近全模型的31.3%,当这些类别被排除在SFT目标标签之外时,显示出类似的选择收益.
在Grid-Loc上,完整的模型保留了明显的优势(51.6%对41.2%),而搁置模型仍然比指示基线大有改进.

blocks.en:
On MCQ, the holdout model improves only modestly over the baseline ( + + 7.1 pp), while the full model gains + + 42.6 pp.
The larger full-versus-holdout gap on MCQ suggests greater sensitivity to the target-label holdout setting, although the comparison also changes the amount and composition of SFT data.
blocks.zh:
在MCQ上,搁置模型仅比基线(++ 7.1pp)稍有改进,而完整的模型增益+ 42.6pp.
MCQ上较大的全控和全控差距表明对目标标签封存设置更加敏感,尽管比较也改变了SFT数据的数量和组成.

blocks.en: The instruct baseline and the full model each show small gaps between retained-category and held-out-category evaluation subsets across all three tasks ( ≤ \leq 1.2 pp). These checks suggest similar aggregate difficulty for these two models, but do not rule out other differences between the subsets or training conditions.
blocks.zh: 指示基线和完整模型均显示所有三项任务中保留类别和保留类别评价子集之间的小差距(\\\\\\\\ 1.2 pp)。 这些检查表明这两种模式的汇总困难相似,但不排除子集或训练条件之间的其他差异.

blocks.en: Under this target-label holdout setting, Grid-Sel and Grid-Loc show larger gains over the instruct baseline than MCQ, supporting transfer beyond categories directly supervised as SFT targets. These task-dependent gains reinforce the value of multi-task evaluation without establishing a strict separation between memorization and generalization.
blocks.zh: 根据这一目标标签的搁置设置,Grid-Sel和Grid-Loc比MCQ显示比指示基线更大的收益,支持作为SFT目标直接监督的类别以外的转移。 这些依赖任务的成果加强了多任务评价的价值,而没有严格区分记忆和概括。
